commands.title: Test Local VM Connectivity
commands.description: Verify private network connectivity between master and worker nodes.

commands.title: SSH into AWS EC2 Node
commands.description: Connect to remote AWS EC2 Ubuntu instance using SSH private key.

commands.title: Set Master Hostname
commands.description: Set system hostname to master01 on control plane instance.

commands.title: Set Worker 1 Hostname
commands.description: Set system hostname to worker01 on first worker instance.

commands.title: Set Worker 2 Hostname
commands.description: Set system hostname to worker02 on second worker instance.

commands.title: Configure Hosts Resolution File
commands.description: Edit /etc/hosts to bind master01, worker01, and worker02 private IPs.

commands.title: Update System Package Index
commands.command: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y apt-transport-https curl
commands.description: Update package repository index and install prerequisite tools.
commands.codeHighlight: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y apt-transport-https curl

commands.title: Install containerd Runtime
commands.description: Install containerd container runtime package across all nodes.

commands.title: Generate Default containerd Configuration
commands.command: sudo mkdir -p /etc/containerd && containerd config default | sudo tee /etc/containerd/config.toml
commands.description: Generate standard containerd configuration file to /etc/containerd/config.toml.
commands.codeHighlight: sudo mkdir -p /etc/containerd && containerd config default | sudo tee /etc/containerd/config.toml

commands.title: Enable Systemd Cgroup Driver
commands.description: Configure containerd to use systemd cgroup driver.
commands.codeHighlight: sudo sed -i 's/SystemdCgroup = false/SystemdCgroup = true/' /etc/containerd/config.toml

commands.title: Restart containerd Daemon
commands.command: sudo systemctl restart containerd && sudo systemctl enable containerd
commands.description: Restart and enable containerd service on boot.
commands.codeHighlight: sudo systemctl restart containerd && sudo systemctl enable containerd

commands.title: Add Kubernetes Package GPG Key
commands.description: Download and dearmor official Kubernetes v1.30 APT repository signing key.
commands.codeHighlight: curl -fsSL https://pkgs.k8s.io/... | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/kubernetes-apt-keyring.gpg

commands.title: Add Kubernetes APT Repository
commands.description: Add official Kubernetes v1.30 repository source to APT lists.

commands.title: Install K8s Components & Hold Version
commands.command: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y kubelet kubeadm kubectl && sudo apt-mark hold kubelet kubeadm kubectl
commands.description: Install kubelet, kubeadm, kubectl and lock versions to prevent accidental upgrades.
commands.codeHighlight: sudo apt-get install -y kubelet kubeadm kubectl && sudo apt-mark hold kubelet kubeadm kubectl

commands.title: Enable Kubelet Service
commands.description: Enable and immediately start kubelet service.

commands.title: Disable Swap Space
commands.description: Disable active swap and remove swap entries from /etc/fstab for Kubernetes compliance.
commands.codeHighlight: sudo swapoff -a && sudo sed -i '/swap/d' /etc/fstab

commands.title: Enable Kernel Bridging & IP Forwarding
commands.command: sudo modprobe br_netfilter && sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
commands.description: Load netfilter bridge module and enable IPv4 forwarding for pod communication.
commands.codeHighlight: sudo modprobe br_netfilter && sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1

commands.title: Initialize Kubernetes Cluster
commands.description: Initialize control plane with advertised master IP and Flannel CIDR.

commands.title: Configure User kubectl Credentials
commands.description: Copy admin kubeconfig to user home directory with proper ownership permissions.
commands.codeHighlight: mkdir -p $HOME/.kube && sudo cp -i /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf $HOME/.kube/config

commands.title: Deploy Flannel CNI Plugin
commands.description: Apply official Flannel Pod Network manifest to cluster.

commands.title: Verify Control Plane Pods
commands.description: List all pods across all namespaces to confirm control plane components are running.

commands.title: Generate Worker Join Command
commands.description: Create a fresh join token and print complete worker join command string.

commands.title: Reset Node State (Clean Rejoin)
commands.command: sudo kubeadm reset -f && sudo rm -rf /etc/kubernetes/ $HOME/.kube /etc/cni/net.d && sudo systemctl restart containerd
commands.description: Force reset kubeadm configuration, clear CNI directories, and restart containerd.
commands.codeHighlight: sudo kubeadm reset -f && sudo rm -rf /etc/kubernetes/ ... && sudo systemctl restart containerd

commands.title: Join Worker Node to Cluster
commands.description: Execute join command on worker node to register with master control plane.
commands.codeHighlight: sudo kubeadm join <MASTER-IP>:6443 --token <TOKEN> --discovery-token-ca-cert-hash sha256:<HASH>

commands.title: List All Cluster Nodes
commands.description: Inspect status of all registered master and worker nodes.

commands.title: Fix NotReady Node (CNI Reset)
commands.command: sudo rm -rf /etc/cni/net.d && sudo systemctl restart containerd && sudo systemctl restart kubelet
commands.description: Clean invalid CNI network files and restart containerd + kubelet daemons.
commands.codeHighlight: sudo rm -rf /etc/cni/net.d && sudo systemctl restart containerd && sudo systemctl restart kubelet

commands.title: Inspect Flannel Pod Status
commands.description: Check details and node placement for all Flannel CNI daemonset pods.
commands.codeHighlight: kubectl get pods -n kube-flannel -o wide

commands.title: Restart All Flannel Pods
commands.description: Force delete all Flannel pods to trigger daemonset recreation.
commands.codeHighlight: kubectl delete pod -n kube-flannel --all

commands.title: Remove Stale SSH Host Key
commands.description: Clear cached host key entry from known_hosts file when VM IP changes.

commands.title: Verify Minikube Prerequisites
commands.description: Verify local installation of Docker daemon and kubectl client CLI.
commands.codeHighlight: docker --version && kubectl version --client

commands.title: SSH into Minikube Node
commands.description: Open direct interactive SSH shell inside the Minikube node environment.

commands.description: Connect to VM driver instance using minikube default RSA key.

commands.description: Enable and open Kubernetes web UI dashboard in default browser.

commands.title: Launch Dashboard in Background Mode
commands.description: Start dashboard service without opening browser and return proxy URL.

commands.title: Get Manager Join Token
commands.description: Display join command and token for adding secondary manager nodes.

commands.title: List All Swarm Cluster Nodes
commands.description: List all active nodes in the swarm along with status, availability, and roles.

commands.title: Leave Swarm Cluster (Worker)
commands.description: Disconnect node from current Docker Swarm cluster.

commands.title: Remove Inactive Node
commands.description: Remove inactive or left worker node entry from manager node registry.

commands.title: Force Remove Unreachable Node
commands.description: Force remove an unresponsive node from manager node state.

commands.title: Verify Node Swarm Info
commands.description: Display overall Docker engine status and Swarm cluster membership details.

commands.title: Promote Worker to Manager
commands.description: Elevate a worker node to manager role in Raft consensus cluster.

commands.title: Demote Manager to Worker
commands.description: Lower manager node role to standard worker node.

commands.title: Create Replicated Swarm Service
commands.description: Create background detached service with 4 container replicas.
commands.codeHighlight: docker service create -d --replicas 4 alpine ping 192.168.64.10

commands.title: List All Swarm Services
commands.description: List all active Swarm services with replica counts and image names.

commands.title: View Tasks of a Service
commands.description: Display tasks (containers) for a specific service and node allocations.

commands.title: Inspect Service Specification
commands.description: Display detailed JSON inspection structure of service configuration.

commands.title: View Service Logs
commands.description: Fetch aggregated STDOUT and STDERR log streams across service tasks.

commands.title: Remove Swarm Service
commands.description: Delete service and terminate all associated running containers.

commands.title: Scale Service Replicas
commands.description: Scale replica count of myservice to 6 instances immediately.

commands.title: Scale Multiple Services Simultaneously
commands.description: Scale multiple services in a single atomic command invocation.

commands.title: Deploy Global Mode Service
commands.command: docker service create --mode global alpine ping 8.8.8.8
commands.description: Deploy global service enforcing exactly one container instance per cluster node.
commands.codeHighlight: docker service create --mode global alpine ping 8.8.8.8

commands.title: Restrict Service to Manager Nodes
commands.description: Schedule service tasks exclusively on manager nodes using role constraints.
commands.codeHighlight: docker service create --replicas 3 --constraint "node.role==manager" alpine ping 192.168.64.10

commands.title: Add Custom Label to Node
commands.description: Attach metadata label ssd=true to target node for placement filtering.

commands.title: Schedule Service Using Node Label
commands.description: Deploy service tasks only onto nodes matching custom label ssd==true.
commands.codeHighlight: docker service create --constraint "node.labels.ssd==true" --replicas 3 alpine ping 192.168.64.10

commands.title: Schedule Using Engine-Level Label
commands.description: Schedule tasks based on daemon.json engine label key-value pairs.
commands.codeHighlight: docker service create --constraint "engine.labels.user==example" --replicas 2 alpine ping 192.168.64.8

commands.title: Test Self-Healing Container Recovery
commands.description: Kill task container manually to observe Swarm self-healing automatic recreation.

commands.title: Inspect Node Details & Diagnostics
commands.description: Output detailed diagnostic JSON manifest for troubleshooting node errors.

commands.title: Verify vmrun CLI & List Running VMs
commands.description: Check that vmrun binary is functional and view count of active VMs.

commands.title: Start VM in Headless Mode (No GUI)
commands.description: Launch target virtual machine in background without spawning graphical desktop window.

commands.title: Start VM with Graphical Interface
commands.description: Launch target virtual machine with VMware Fusion GUI console window.

commands.title: Graceful VM Shutdown (Soft)
commands.description: Send graceful OS shutdown signal via VMware Tools.

commands.title: Force Power Off VM (Hard)
commands.description: Immediately power off virtual machine (equivalent to pulling power plug).

commands.title: Graceful Restart VM
commands.description: Send graceful OS reboot request to running virtual machine.

commands.title: Pause Execution of Running VM
commands.description: Freeze CPU execution state of virtual machine instantly.

commands.title: Resume Execution of Paused VM
commands.description: Unfreeze CPU state and resume execution of paused virtual machine.

commands.title: Batch Stop All Running VMs
commands.command: vmrun -T fusion list | tail -n +2 | while read vm; do echo "Stopping: $vm"; vmrun -T fusion stop "$vm" soft; done
commands.description: Shell loop script to gracefully shut down every running virtual machine.
commands.codeHighlight: vmrun -T fusion list | tail -n +2 | while read vm; do vmrun -T fusion stop "$vm" soft; done
